title: VTA PCS — Voter Read — payload
description: A voter's client asks its VTA for a vtc/elections/list or vtc/elections/show request signed as the voter's membership DID, so the client can read the community's elections as the member without holding the member's key.

contextId.description: The context the voter belongs to.

community.description: The community's DID: the recipient of the signed request.

member.description: The voter's membership DID at the community. MUST be a DID the engine holds an authentication key of that the caller may act as.

read.description: Which read to sign: vtc/elections/list/0.1 or vtc/elections/show/0.1.

payload.description: The request payload of that task, validated against its own schema.

ReadDocument.title: ReadDocument
ReadDocument.description: A complete, signed vtc/elections/list/0.1 or vtc/elections/show/0.1 request document, ready to send to the community unchanged.

proof.description: A Data Integrity proof by an `authentication` key of `issuer`.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Voter Read — response payload
Response.description: The signed read, to send to the community.
